analyzed_vuln.description: TLVRecordReader::getNextTLVRecord performs pointer arithmetic using the untrusted current record's getTotalSize() before proving that size fits in the remaining TLV buffer. When the aligned NFLOG recordLen exceeds the remaining bytes, the expression used as canAssign()'s length (`tlvDataBasePtr - recordBase + tlvDataLen - recordSize`) underflows as size_t and becomes huge, so canAssign succeeds. The function then assigns `recordBase + recordSize`—an out-of-bounds pointer—to resRec and calls resRec.getTotalSize(), causing the 2-byte heap OOB read in NflogTlv::getTotalSize. Its later bounds check occurs only after this unsafe dereference. The fix should validate the current record offset and size against the buffer using non-overflowing subtraction before constructing or dereferencing the next-record pointer.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A captured packet must be decoded as NFLOG and contain more than the 4-byte nflog_header so parseNextLayer searches its TLVs for NFULA_PAYLOAD. A visited TLV must not have the requested payload type and must supply a nonzero recordLen whose 4-byte-aligned total size is greater than the bytes remaining from that TLV to the end of the NFLOG data. In this PoV, the first TLV's little-endian recordLen is 0x3200 (aligned size 12800) despite only roughly 50 TLV bytes being available. The oversized length underflows getNextTLVRecord's remaining-length calculation, bypasses canAssign, and advances far beyond the packet allocation before reading the supposed next TLV length.

args: Analyze the root cause and safest minimal fix for TLVRecordReader::getNextTLVRecord in PcapPlusPlus/Packet++/header/TLVData.h, especially malformed records whose getTotalSize() exceeds the remaining TLV data. Identify related methods/invariants and whether getFirstTLVRecord or other APIs have similar unsafe behavior.

The supplied ASan report shows NflogLayer parsing a malformed NflogTlv. The current TLV has recordLen 0x3200 and aligned getTotalSize() 12800 while only about 50 bytes remain. In getNextTLVRecord, a size_t expression used for canAssign underflows, then recordBase + recordSize is assigned and getTotalSize() dereferences an OOB pointer. We need patch only C/C++ under PcapPlusPlus, preserve behavior, and validate offsets/sizes using subtraction before pointer construction/dereference.
